segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the scope from last week: 42 user seats, the calibration workflow module, and the asset import service for your three labs. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that's right. We may add two more supervisors later, but for the initial order it's 42. The go-live target is still May 6.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, May 6 works. On implementation, our services team has you down for a March 18 kickoff, then about six weeks for configuration, import, and validation. The asset file you sent had 3,860 records, so that fits the standard import package.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. One question on invoices. Can you split the subscription and implementation fees? Finance wants the annual subscription on one invoice and the services on a separate PO.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can do that. The subscription would be $31,920 for the year, and implementation is $8,400 one-time. I'll note separate POs in the CRM and have billing issue two invoices.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. And the term is 12 months, not 36, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, 12 months. The order form starts April 1, 2026 and runs through March 31, 2027. Renewal language is annual, with 60 days notice if you don't want to renew.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Legal had one redline on the data retention section. They want 45 days after termination instead of 30. Is that something deal desk needs to approve?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It does, but that one's usually straightforward. I'll send it to deal desk this afternoon and get you an updated order form by tomorrow morning, assuming no issues.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. If we have the revised order form tomorrow, I can route it for signature Friday. Then we should be clear for the March kickoff.
